A triangular pyramid puzzle piece: an equilateral triangular base of 50mm side length, rising to a sharp apex at a height of 45mm. All three vertical side faces have a central rectangular slot cut into them, each slot being 10mm wide and 15mm high.

A marble run curved track segment: a flat base channel 60mm long, 30mm wide, and 12mm thick. Carved into the top is a semicircular groove of 10mm radius running in a 90-degree arc from one side to the adjacent side.

A mechanical puzzle cylinder: a hollow cylinder 45mm in outer diameter and 70mm high, with a 3mm wall thickness. Cut into the outer cylindrical surface is a helical track groove that is 4mm wide and 1.5mm deep, making 1.5 full turns around the body.

A toy coin or token: a flat circular disc 35mm in diameter and 3mm thick. On both flat faces, there is a concentric circular raised boss of 25mm diameter and 0.8mm height, with a ribbed knurled edge around the 35mm perimeter.

A miniature balance beam toy: a central triangular fulcrum base 30mm wide, 20mm deep, and 25mm high, supporting a horizontal beam 120mm long, 15mm wide, and 8mm thick. Each end of the beam has a vertical through-hole of 5mm diameter for hanging pans.

A puzzle interlocking grid piece: a cross-shaped plate formed from a central 30mm x 30mm square with four 30mm x 30mm arms extending from each side, all 6mm thick. Each arm features a central rectangular slot 10mm wide and 15mm long.
